conflicts.description: contradictions between the feature's sources (a diff of every normalised source's claims); an `open` one makes gate-spec raise exactly one CLARIFY listing them all, with default_winner proposed

source.description: inbox file or SRC id the claim comes from

default_winner.description: the source whose claim wins unless the human decides otherwise: the user's own brief (the shortest or first-person source, or the one the inbox marks as base)

resolution.description: required once resolved: which claim holds and why (the human's answer, HD-n, or the default)
